0022600217.text: The Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home) host the Wizards (4-7) with Indiana 11th in the East and on a two-game losing streak, while Washington is 10th in the East and has lost four straight. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Bilal Coulibaly listed as day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20, 2026.
